# Proposal — policies-section

## Problem
Potential guests have no clear, scannable summary of house rules and booking conditions on the landing page. Information is scattered across the FAQ, generating pre-booking friction and post-booking disputes.

## Target Users
Potential guests visiting the landing page before deciding to book. Need quick-scan summary of payment conditions, cancellation policy, pet acceptance, and check-in/check-out times.

## Business Rules
1. **Reserva con Seña** — La reserva se confirma abonando el 30% de la estadía.
2. **Sin Reembolso** — Una vez señada la reserva no se realiza reembolso. Rescheduling allowed; price may vary.
3. **Mascotas Bienvenidas** — All types of pets accepted, no quantity limit, no breed/size restrictions.
4. **Check-in / Check-out** — Check-in: 12:00 hs. Check-out: 10:00 hs. Late check-out available at additional cost — "consultanos" (no price shown).

## Scope
### In scope
- CREATE components/sections/policies-section.tsx — ACCORDION layout (user chose accordion, not card grid)
- MODIFY app/page.tsx — import + insert after disponibilidad, before FAQSection  
- MODIFY components/layouts/floating-navbar.tsx — add { label: "Políticas", id: "politicas" } after "Disponibilidad"
- Estimated: ~70–90 LOC

### Out of scope
- Removing/modifying FAQ items
- Displaying late check-out price
- Any backend changes

## Risks
1. Navbar overflow at md breakpoint with 7 items
2. Content overlap with FAQ (intentional — summary vs detail)
3. Background alternation drift if sections reordered

## Success Criteria
1. Section visible at id="politicas" between AvailabilitySection and FAQSection
2. Four accordion items with accurate Spanish copy
3. "Políticas" navbar link scrolls to section
4. Visual consistency: Playfair heading, terracotta primary, bg-muted/30
5. No existing sections altered
6. No TypeScript/ESLint errors
